_comment: Template for merge_omg4_segments.py. Each segment owns the t_center range [start, end); null means unbounded, which the first and last segments want because trained t_centers drift outside the clip window and their temporal tails still do useful in-window work. Seams are placed on half-frame boundaries (e.g. 14.5/29.97) so no frame's Gaussians sit exactly on a cut. fade_zones is needed only for --mode fade, one [t0, t1] per seam, each ending at its seam. Paths are relative to the manifest unless --segment_dir is given.
